Name: NPC_THINK_PARAM_ST
Description: Enemy AI settings: senses (sight, hearing, smell, radar), search and forget timers, return-home distances, pathing and jump-edge settings, target sharing, and the logic and battle goal scripts. Each enemy uses one row.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Development flag for network-test builds.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Product
Fields.Description: Exclude this row from the retail build.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Reserve 1
Fields.Description: Reserved for package output flags.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Reserve 2
Fields.Description: Reserved for package output flags.

Fields.Name: Logic ID
Fields.Description: ID of the logic script that runs this AI.

Fields.Name: Battle Goal ID
Fields.Description: ID of the battle goal script the logic uses in combat.

Fields.Name: Vision - Search Distance
Fields.Description: Sight range used while searching for a target. In metres.

Fields.Name: Vision - Search Height Angle
Fields.Description: Vertical sight angle used while searching for a target. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Vision - Search Width Angle
Fields.Description: Horizontal sight angle used while searching for a target. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Script Type
Fields.Description: Type of script the AI is interpreted as.

Fields.Name: Goal Action - Cannot Reacquire Target
Fields.Description: Goal action when the target can no longer be reacquired.

Fields.Name: Cover Action Release Distance
Fields.Description: Distance at which the cover action ends. In metres.

Fields.Name: Search Forget Time - Level 1
Fields.Description: Time before a search level 1 target is forgotten. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Search Forget Time - Level 2
Fields.Description: Time before a search level 2 target is forgotten. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Back Home Time on Touching Enemy Wall
Fields.Description: Duration of the return-home goal when the NPC touches an enemy wall that blocks its area. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Vision - Search Forget Time
Fields.Description: Time before a target found by sight is forgotten. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Blocked Movement - Anim ID
Fields.Description: EzState action the NPC performs automatically when a breakable object stops its movement.

Fields.Name: Listen - Distance
Fields.Description: Hearing range. In metres.

Fields.Name: Call Help - Action Animation ID
Fields.Description: Animation ID (EzState) played when answering a call for help.

Fields.Name: Call Help - Call Action ID
Fields.Description: Action ID (EzState) played when calling allies for help.

Fields.Name: Vision - Distance
Fields.Description: Sight range. In metres.

Fields.Name: Retreat Home - Guard Action ID
Fields.Description: Action performed while returning home and facing the target, intended for guarding. 0: disabled.

Fields.Name: Listen - Sound Cutoff Distance
Fields.Description: Distance by which sound sources are shrunk for this NPC: sounds within this distance are no longer heard. In metres.

Fields.Name: Smell - Distance
Fields.Description: Smell range. In metres.

Fields.Name: Retreat Home - Max Distance
Fields.Description: Distance from home beyond which the NPC returns home no matter what. In metres.

Fields.Name: Retreat Home - Distance
Fields.Description: Distance from home beyond which the NPC returns home while still fighting. In metres.

Fields.Name: Retreat Home - Battle Distance
Fields.Description: Distance at which the NPC gives up returning home and fights instead. In metres.

Fields.Name: Non-Battle Act Duration when in Combat
Fields.Description: Duration of non-combat behaviour while the NPC is aware of an enemy. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Retreat Home - Look for Target Time
Fields.Description: Time the NPC keeps looking at the target while returning home. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Retreat Home - Look for Target Distance
Fields.Description: Distance within which the NPC looks at the target while returning home. In metres.

Fields.Name: Listen - Search Forget Time
Fields.Description: Time before a sound target is forgotten. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Battle - Start Distance
Fields.Description: Distance at which combat starts. In metres.

Fields.Name: Call Help - My Peer ID
Fields.Description: This NPC's ally group ID for calls for help.

Fields.Name: Call Help - Call Peer ID
Fields.Description: Ally group ID this NPC calls for help.

Fields.Name: Target System - Damage Effect Rate
Fields.Description: Percentage weight of damage taken when the target system evaluates which character to target.

Fields.Name: Team Attack Effectivity
Fields.Description: A value for determining the number of simultaneous attacks in a team. Increasing the value reduces the number of people who can participate in the attack at the same time.

Fields.Name: Vision - Height Angle
Fields.Description: Vertical sight angle. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Vision - Width Angle
Fields.Description: Horizontal sight angle. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Disable Darkness Modifier to Distance
Fields.Description: ON: the alert vision distance and battle start distance are not affected by darkness.

Fields.Name: Caravan Role
Fields.Description: Role in the caravan

Fields.Name: Call Help - Valid Target Min Distance
Fields.Description: Allies are not called while the target is closer than this. In metres.

Fields.Name: Call Help - Valid Target Range
Fields.Description: Allies farther away than this are not called. In metres.

Fields.Name: Call Help - Forget Time by Arrival
Fields.Description: Time after answering a call for help before the call is forgotten. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Call Help - Min Wait Time
Fields.Description: Minimum time of the first wait in the reply goal, in tenths of a second (101 = 10.1 s).

Fields.Name: Call Help - Max Wait Time
Fields.Description: Maximum time of the first wait in the reply goal, in tenths of a second (101 = 10.1 s).

Fields.Name: Goal Action - Search Level 1
Fields.Description: Goal action when the target reaches search level 1.

Fields.Name: Goal Action - Search Level 2
Fields.Description: Goal action when the target reaches search level 2.

Fields.Name: Call Help - Reply Behavior Type
Fields.Description: Movement type used to reach the target position after answering a call for help.

Fields.Name: Disable Path Move
Fields.Description: ON: the NPC moves directly to its destination instead of following the path, even when given a path move order.

Fields.Name: Skip Arrival Visibility Check
Fields.Description: ON: arrival is judged even without line of sight to the destination.

Fields.Name: Think Attribute - Do Admirer
Fields.Description: ON: the NPC plays a surrounding (admirer) role.

Fields.Name: Navigation - Edge
Fields.Description: ON: the NPC can path through navmesh nodes marked Cliff. Default: ON.

Fields.Name: Navigation - Large Space
Fields.Description: ON: the NPC can path through navmesh nodes marked Wide. Default: ON.

Fields.Name: Navigation - Ladder
Fields.Description: ON: the NPC can path through navmesh nodes marked Ladder. Default: OFF.

Fields.Name: Navigation - Hole
Fields.Description: ON: the NPC can path through navmesh nodes marked Hole. Default: OFF.

Fields.Name: Navigation - Door
Fields.Description: ON: the NPC can path through navmesh nodes marked Door. Default: OFF.

Fields.Name: Navigation - Inside Wall
Fields.Description: ON: the NPC can path through navmesh nodes marked Inside Wall. Default: OFF.

Fields.Name: Padding
Fields.Description: Padding.

Fields.Name: Navigation - Cliff Edge
Fields.Description: ON: the NPC can path through Cliff nodes while in the normal or alert state. Default: ON.

Fields.Name: Navigation - Reserved
Fields.Description: Reserved for a future navigation flag.

Fields.Name: Search Threshold - Level 0 to Level 1
Fields.Description: Search value at which search level 0 becomes level 1.

Fields.Name: Search Threshold - Level 1 to Level 2
Fields.Description: Search value at which search level 1 becomes level 2.

Fields.Name: Platoon - Reply Time
Fields.Description: Delay before the NPC reacts to its platoon. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Platoon - Reply Add Random Time
Fields.Description: Random extra time added to the platoon reaction delay. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Virtual Camera Horizontal Field of View
Fields.Description: Horizontal angle used to judge whether the virtual camera has caught the target. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Virtual Camera Vertical Field of View
Fields.Description: Vertical angle used to judge whether the virtual camera has caught the target. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Virtual Camera Follows Target
Fields.Description: ON: the virtual camera turns to follow the target. OFF: it stays fixed forward.

Fields.Name: Reaction When Hit While Unspotted
Fields.Description: How the NPC reacts when it is hit before it has found its target.

Fields.Name: Turret Mode Release Distance
Fields.Description: Distance at which fixed turret mode is released (distance-based release). In metres.

Fields.Name: Target Forget Time After Damage
Fields.Description: Time before the target is forgotten in the hit state. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Raycast Distance for Target Keeping
Fields.Description: Raycast distance used to keep the current target. In metres.

Fields.Name: Use Boost Rise
Fields.Description: ON: jumps use the boost rise operation instead of system movement.

Fields.Name: Accept Target Sharing
Fields.Description: OFF: the NPC accepts no shared targets at all, for search or combat.

Fields.Name: Vision - Origin Back Offset
Fields.Description: The sight origin is this far behind the character's centre. In metres.

Fields.Name: Vision - Cut Distance
Fields.Description: Targets closer than this to the sight origin are not seen. In metres.

Fields.Name: Action Type When Pathfinding Fails
Fields.Description: The default action to take when the end point of an alternative path is reached or when a path search fails.

Fields.Name: Goal Action - Normal State
Fields.Description: Goal action during the normal state.

Fields.Name: Path Search Cost Param ID
Fields.Description: Determines pathfinding costs.

Fields.Name: Action Type When Pathfinding Fails (Non-Combat)
Fields.Description: With no target, the action taken after the NPC's home position is reset to its current location.

Fields.Name: Is Buddy AI
Fields.Description: Thoughts for a buddy? (Unused)

Fields.Name: Goal Action - To Caution (Sound)
Fields.Description: Goal action when the NPC becomes alert from hearing a normal sound.

Fields.Name: Goal Action - To Caution (Important Sound)
Fields.Description: Goal action when the NPC becomes alert from hearing an important sound.

Fields.Name: Allow Jumps While Moving
Fields.Description: ON: the NPC moves across jump user edges by jumping over them.

Fields.Name: Disable Local Steering
Fields.Description: ON: turns off local steering, the behaviour of moving around other characters. Possibly unused.

Fields.Name: Goal Action - To Caution (Threat Sound)
Fields.Description: Goal action when the NPC becomes alert from hearing a threat sound.

Fields.Name: Goal Action - Forced Return Home
Fields.Description: Goal action when the NPC enters the state of returning home no matter what.

Fields.Name: Memory Target Forget Time
Fields.Description: Time before a remembered target is forgotten. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Goal Action - Return Home While Fighting
Fields.Description: Goal action when the NPC starts returning home while fighting.

Fields.Name: Search Vision Occlusion
Fields.Description: ON: search vision is blocked by obstacles (raycast). OFF: no occlusion.

Fields.Name: Always Align Vision To Dummy Poly
Fields.Description: ON: vision always faces the direction of the reference dummy poly (dummy poly ID 250).

Fields.Name: Share Target Type
Fields.Description: Sets the type of target to share to.

Fields.Name: Goal Action - Discovered State
Fields.Description: Goal action when the NPC finds its target.

Fields.Name: Goal Action - Searching State
Fields.Description: Goal action during the search state.

Fields.Name: Goal Action - Target Lost
Fields.Description: Goal action when the NPC loses its target.

Fields.Name: Goal Action - Start Normal State
Fields.Description: Action when transitioning to normal state.

Fields.Name: Goal Action - ID
Fields.Description: ID for general AI behavior outside of combat (only valid when the script type is Operation).

Fields.Name: Sound Behavior ID [1]
Fields.Description: Behaviour ID of sound targets this NPC can hear. Up to eight IDs can be set. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Sound Behavior ID [2]
Fields.Description: See Sound Behavior ID [1].

Fields.Name: Sound Behavior ID [3]
Fields.Description: See Sound Behavior ID [1].

Fields.Name: Sound Behavior ID [4]
Fields.Description: See Sound Behavior ID [1].

Fields.Name: Sound Behavior ID [5]
Fields.Description: See Sound Behavior ID [1].

Fields.Name: Sound Behavior ID [6]
Fields.Description: See Sound Behavior ID [1].

Fields.Name: Sound Behavior ID [7]
Fields.Description: See Sound Behavior ID [1].

Fields.Name: Sound Behavior ID [8]
Fields.Description: See Sound Behavior ID [1].

Fields.Name: Event Target - Enemy Priority Distance
Fields.Description: While an enemy is closer than this, combat takes priority over the event target. In metres (0-9999).

Fields.Name: Event Target - Fight While Approaching Distance
Fields.Description: While the event target is at least this far away, the NPC heads to it while fighting. In metres (0-9999).

Fields.Name: Event Target - Approach Priority Distance
Fields.Description: While the event target is at least this far away, heading to it takes top priority. In metres (0-9999).

Fields.Name: Vision - Radar
Fields.Description: Radar detection range. In metres.

Fields.Name: Vision - Upper Altitude Limit
Fields.Description: Upper altitude limit of normal vision. In metres.

Fields.Name: Vision - Lower Altitude Limit
Fields.Description: Lower altitude limit of normal vision. In metres.

Fields.Name: Vision - Search Upper Altitude Limit
Fields.Description: Upper altitude limit of search vision. In metres.

Fields.Name: Vision - Search Lower Altitude Limit
Fields.Description: Lower altitude limit of search vision. In metres.

Fields.Name: Search Target Share Distance
Fields.Description: Range within which search targets are shared. In metres.

Fields.Name: Attack Target Share Distance
Fields.Description: Range within which attack targets are shared. In metres.

Fields.Name: Search Target Share Speed
Fields.Description: Speed at which the sharing range grows over time, from 0 m up to Search Target Share Distance. In metres per second. -1: share across the full range at once.

Fields.Name: Attack Target Share Speed
Fields.Description: Speed at which the sharing range grows over time, from 0 m up to Attack Target Share Distance. In metres per second. -1: share across the full range at once.

Fields.Name: Player - Enemy Priority Distance
Fields.Description: While an enemy is closer than this, combat takes priority over the player. In metres (0-9999).

Fields.Name: Player - Fight While Approaching Distance
Fields.Description: While the player is at least this far away, the NPC heads to the player while fighting. In metres (0-9999).

Fields.Name: Player - Approach Priority Distance
Fields.Description: While the player is at least this far away, heading to the player takes top priority. In metres (0-9999).

Fields.Name: Fixed Turret Mode - Disable Distance When Hit
Fields.Description: Distance at which fixed turret mode is released when hit. In metres.

Fields.Name: Vision - Search Origin Back Offset
Fields.Description: Sight origin back offset for search vision. In metres.

Fields.Name: Vision - Search Cut Distance
Fields.Description: Cut distance for search vision: targets closer than this to the sight origin are not seen. In metres.

Fields.Name: Vision - Search 2 Distance
Fields.Description: Sight range of the second, close-range search vision. In metres.

Fields.Name: Vision - Search 2 Height Angle
Fields.Description: Vertical sight angle of the close-range search vision. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Vision - Search 2 Width Angle
Fields.Description: Horizontal sight angle of the close-range search vision. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Vision - Search 2 Upper Altitude Limit
Fields.Description: Upper altitude limit of the close-range search vision. In metres.

Fields.Name: Vision - Search 2 Lower Altitude Limit
Fields.Description: Lower altitude limit of the close-range search vision. In metres.

Fields.Name: Vision - Search 2 Origin Back Offset
Fields.Description: Sight origin back offset for the close-range search vision. In metres.

Fields.Name: Vision - Search 2 Cut Distance
Fields.Description: Cut distance for the close-range search vision. In metres.

Fields.Name: Search Level Share Distance
Fields.Description: Distance within which characters share their search level values. In metres. Reportedly unused.

Fields.Name: Engagement Share Distance
Fields.Description: (Unused) The distance at which characters share their engagement values. In meters.

Fields.Name: Search Level Share Rate
Fields.Description: Rate at which a character's search level value is shared.

Fields.Name: Engagement Share Rate
Fields.Description: Rate at which a character's engagement value is shared.

Fields.Name: Vision - Battle Distance
Fields.Description: Sight range used in the combat state. In metres.

Fields.Name: Vision - Battle Height Angle
Fields.Description: Vertical sight angle used in the combat state. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Vision - Battle Width Angle
Fields.Description: Horizontal sight angle used in the combat state. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Vision - Battle Upper Altitude Limit
Fields.Description: Upper altitude limit of combat-state vision. In metres.

Fields.Name: Vision - Battle Lower Altitude Limit
Fields.Description: Lower altitude limit of combat-state vision. In metres.

Fields.Name: Vision - Battle Origin Back Offset
Fields.Description: Sight origin back offset for combat-state vision. In metres.

Fields.Name: Vision - Battle Cut Distance
Fields.Description: Cut distance for combat-state vision. In metres.

Fields.Name: Radar Performance
Fields.Description: A performance value that compares the target's stealth performance to determine whether it can be detected by radar.

Fields.Name: General Attack - Equipment Part
Fields.Description: Equipment slot used for general attacks, as an AI weapon place number. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Launch AI Layer: MOVE01
Fields.Description: Starts AI layer MOVE01 (layer ID 2) when set.

Fields.Name: Launch AI Layer: MOVETYPE
Fields.Description: Starts AI layer MOVETYPE (layer ID 3) when set.

Fields.Name: Launch AI Layer: ATTACK01

Fields.Name: Launch AI Layer: ATTACK04

Fields.Name: Launch AI Layer: EXTRA01
Fields.Description: Starts AI layer EXTRA01 (layer ID 8) when set.

Fields.Name: Launch AI Layer: INTERRUPT
Fields.Description: Starts AI layer INTERRUPT (layer ID 9) when set.

Fields.Name: General Attack - Distance
Fields.Description: Range of general attacks. In metres.

Fields.Name: Cover Attack - Distance
Fields.Description: Attack distance for the cover action. In metres.

Fields.Name: Shared Target Recognition Delay
Fields.Description: Delay between receiving a shared target and recognising it. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Shared Target Time After Death
Fields.Description: Time target sharing continues after the character dies, counted from when the sharing range reaches its maximum. In seconds. 0: sharing stops at death even if the range has not reached its maximum.

Fields.Name: General AI Parameter 00
Fields.Description: General-purpose AI parameter, carried over from Debug AI Parameter 00 for the retail build.

Fields.Name: General AI Parameter 01
Fields.Description: General-purpose AI parameter, carried over from Debug AI Parameter 01 for the retail build.

Fields.Name: General AI Parameter 02
Fields.Description: General-purpose AI parameter, carried over from Debug AI Parameter 02 for the retail build.

Fields.Name: General AI Parameter 03
Fields.Description: General-purpose AI parameter, carried over from Debug AI Parameter 03 for the retail build.

Fields.Name: General AI Parameter 04
Fields.Description: General-purpose AI parameter, carried over from Debug AI Parameter 04 for the retail build.

Fields.Name: Path Search Wait Time
Fields.Description: A path search taking longer than this is treated as failed. In seconds. -1: left to Havok.

Fields.Name: Jump Edge - Start Reach Distance Offset
Fields.Description: Used to check whether the character has entered a jump edge. The character's hit radius is added separately. In metres.

Fields.Name: Jump Edge - End Reach Height Offset
Fields.Description: Maximum allowed height for the jump edge end check. The character's hit height is added separately. In metres.

Fields.Name: Jump Edge - End Reach Horizontal Distance
Fields.Description: Maximum allowed horizontal distance for the jump edge end check. In metres.

Fields.Name: Jump Edge - End Reach Angle
Fields.Description: The end is treated as reached when the angle between (current position to end) and (start to end) exceeds this. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Jump Edge - End Ground Check Offset
Fields.Description: Offset of the raycast that checks for ground underfoot at the jump edge end. The height difference between the current position and the end is added separately. In metres.

Fields.Name: Jump Edge - Fall Height
Fields.Description: Minimum height treated as a fall when dropping from a jump edge. In metres.

Fields.Name: Jump Edge - Fall Horizontal Distance
Fields.Description: Maximum horizontal distance the character can fall from a jump edge. In metres.

Fields.Name: Navmesh Path Search Iteration Limit
Fields.Description: Maximum iterations for navmesh path searches. -1: left to Havok (10000). Higher values allow longer paths, but searches for unreachable spots (such as behind terrain) take longer.

Fields.Name: Nav Volume Path Search Iteration Limit
Fields.Description: Maximum iterations for nav volume path searches. -1: left to Havok (10000). Higher values allow longer paths, but searches for unreachable spots (such as behind terrain) take longer.

Fields.Name: Skip Occlusion Check for Dummy Characters
Fields.Description: OFF: follows Search Vision Occlusion. ON: no raycast occlusion check against dummy characters.

Fields.Name: Use Initial Position as Last Landing Point
Fields.Description: ON: the initial position can be used as the last landing position. A bug-fix switch, kept as a param to limit its effect.

Fields.Name: Wait During Path Search on Jump Edge
Fields.Description: ON: the character waits while a path search runs on a jump edge. Fixes characters using boost rise that kept climbing when told to wait during a path search.

Fields.Name: Jump Edge - End Reach Raycast Radius
Fields.Description: Raycast radius for the jump edge end check. A positive value overrides the default character hit radius. In metres.
